svg.text: INTERACTION DESIGN · ADD TRANSACTION FLOW · ALL STATES
5 states · empty → entry → error handling → category → success · 3-tap maximum from any state
Add your first one to start
If it looks like a broken product,
users won't trust what comes next.
The wallet icon + balance card at ₹0
shows the app is working, just empty.
Error text appears inline below the
amount — never as a modal or toast.
The fix (type a number) and the
state uses violet fill — same as CTA.
A task completed should feel good.
clear next actions, no dead end.
INTERACTION PRINCIPLES APPLIED IN THIS FLOW
Category grid is visible but muted until amount
is entered. User knows it exists — the order is clear.
vs. hiding it: users didn't know categories existed
Error message appears directly below the field
that needs fixing. No toast, no modal, no scroll.
In testing: modals caused users to lose their input
Amount → Category → Save. Every state in this
flow was pressure-tested against this constraint.
Adding a note is optional — it doesn't block Save
